answer: Treat the network as a graph where each agent is a vertex and each edge is a graded interaction with a different operator. Sybil clusters look like a dune: a big mound of accounts piled up behind a few thin links to the honest region. Cap the reward that can flow across any small cut, so a farm of a thousand accounts earns roughly what its handful of real connections justify. Honest trust, like quartz, forms slowly and holds under pressure.
